meta.seo_title: aBeam — On-Demand Boat Concierge, San Francisco
meta.seo_description: Shore-side concierge and trip management for captains, crews and owners at San Francisco’s city marinas. Text us what the boat needs.
meta.tagline: By your side, Beyond the shore

hero.headline: Text us what the boat needs. We’ll handle it.
hero.subhead: aBeam is a shore-side concierge for captains, crews and owners at San Francisco’s city marinas. Text us what the boat needs, from provisions and parts to a return chased or a slip at the next stop, and we do it on land so the crew can stay aboard.
hero.micro: Same-day requests welcome. Launching at South Beach, Pier 39 and Marina Green.

showcase.headline: One text covers the whole boat.
showcase.intro: Orbit the boat and open a zone. Deck, cabin, engine room, hull: each is something you can ask us for, most of it handled from the dock.
showcase.hint: Drag to orbit · Tap a marker or a chip

hotspots.label: Whole boat
hotspots.title: The whole trip, coordinated.
hotspots.tooltip: Slips, fuel, provisions, vendors. We’ll keep the list; you keep the boat.
hotspots.body: Berths at the next stop, fuel and pump-out timing, provisioning by the day, vendors booked before you leave and chased while you’re out. One point of contact, every request logged.

hotspots.label: Hull & exterior
hotspots.title: Haul-out, bottom, rigging: booked and chased.
hotspots.tooltip: The yard wants a date. We’ll get one, and hold them to it.
hotspots.body: When the hull needs the yard, we get the quotes, book the slot and keep you posted until she’s back in the water. We coordinate; the yard does the work.

hotspots.label: Deck
hotspots.title: Ice in, provisions handed aboard.
hotspots.tooltip: Ice, drinks, groceries, the part you’re waiting on. Handed over at the dock.
hotspots.body: Text a list and it arrives at the dock when you said: ice, drinks, groceries, parts, packages. We hand it aboard, and take the trash and empties off.

hotspots.label: Cabin
hotspots.title: The errands ashore, so the crew stays aboard.
hotspots.tooltip: Laundry out, a refund chased, a package collected. Nothing to leave the boat for.
hotspots.body: Returns and refunds, laundry, pickups, the small jobs ashore that would otherwise take a crew member off the boat for an afternoon. Text it, we do it, you get a note when it’s done.

hotspots.label: Engine room
hotspots.title: We flag it. We don’t fix it.
hotspots.tooltip: Oil’s a shade dark. Noted, and the mechanic’s number is ready.
hotspots.body: Anything we notice that looks off, you hear at once, and we stop there. If you want it fixed, we line up a trusted local marine mechanic and coordinate the visit.

how.headline: Three steps. One text starts it.
how.intro: Built for the specific ask: fuel and ice by 1pm, a diver next week, a part picked up before the weekend. Text it and we take it from there.

steps.title: Text us what you need
steps.body: Boat name, marina, slip, what needs doing and by when. A text is fastest; the short form below reaches the same people.

steps.title: We confirm what we can do, and when
steps.body: One reply: what we’ll handle, a ready-by time, and the fee. If it’s outside what we do, we say so and point you to someone who does it well.

steps.title: It’s handled
steps.body: You get a text when it’s done, with a note of what was done and who came aboard, if anyone did.

included.headline: The land-side list, handled.
included.intro: The requests we’re built around. Ask for any of it, and it’s done the same way every time and logged the same way.

items.title: Provisioning
items.line: Ice, drinks and groceries bought and brought to the dock at the time you said.

items.title: Parts & pickups
items.line: Chandlery runs, parts collected, packages received and met at the gate.

items.title: Returns & refunds
items.line: Wrong part, wrong size, changed plans: we take it back and chase the refund.

items.title: Fuel, water & propane
items.line: Jerry cans filled and returned, fresh water topped off, propane exchanged.

items.title: Errands ashore
items.line: Trash off, laundry out and back, the small jobs that would take a crew member off the boat.

items.title: Conditions brief
items.line: Wind, tide and weather for your route, texted before you leave.

included.footnote: Anything we notice aboard, we flag to the captain. We don’t repair. If you want it fixed, we line up a trusted local marine mechanic and coordinate the visit.

brief_sample.message: For your 1pm: fog lifting off Alcatraz, sun by noon. Westerly 12 kts now, 20+ in the Slot by 3. Max ebb 2:40 at the Gate, so expect chop past Crissy. Provisions at the dock by 12:30.
brief_sample.caption: The brief that lands before you’ve left for the dock.

services.headline: Ask for what the boat needs.
services.intro: Three ways we work. All of them start with a text, and most of them are handled from the dock.

cards.title: Concierge
cards.body: Provisions, parts, returns and refunds, pickups, deliveries, errands. The land-side list, handled so the crew stays with the boat.

cards.title: Trip management
cards.body: Berths at the next stop, fuel and pump-out timing, provisioning by the day, vendors booked before you leave and chased while you’re away. One point of contact, every request logged.

cards.title: Repairs & Maintenance
cards.body: We flag, we don’t fix. Anything that looks off goes to the captain at once, and if you want it handled we line up a trusted local marine mechanic, rigger or canvas shop and see the job through.

services.more: A diver arranged, a part collected, a refund chased, a surveyor met. Text us and ask. If it’s not something we do, we’ll tell you who does.

marinas.headline: Built for boats at three city marinas.
marinas.intro: South Beach Harbor beside Oracle Park, Pier 39 at Fisherman’s Wharf, and the San Francisco Marina at Marina Green. Tap a pin for status and berths.
marinas.footnote: A marina shows as serving only once we’ve confirmed dock access there. Not listed, or still coming soon? Text us and we’ll tell you where things stand.

trust.headline: Who was aboard, and what was done.
trust.intro: Handing your keys to someone you haven’t met takes trust. Here is what we can show for it.

points.title: Fully insured for boat access
points.body: Marinas require it; ask us for the certificate any time. We work within your marina’s vendor rules, not around them.

points.title: Every request logged
points.body: What was asked, what was done, when, and who came aboard if anyone did. Written down every time, and in your text.

points.title: Small, local, vetted team
points.body: Not a franchise, not a rotating roster of contractors. A few people we’ve vetted ourselves, who know these docks and know each other. You’ll know their names.

points.title: We flag. We don’t fix.
points.body: Anything we notice aboard goes to the captain at once, and we stop there. If you want it handled, we line up a trusted local marine mechanic and coordinate the visit.

pricing.headline: Quoted per request, agreed up front.
pricing.price_note: Every request is quoted before we start, typically $75–150 depending on scope. Purchases, fuel and provisions are added at cost, receipts included. No hourly clock.
pricing.includes_line: Quote by text before we start. Receipts with the note when it’s done.
pricing.membership_body: For boats that need us often. We’re working out the terms now. Leave your number and you’ll hear when it’s ready, and not before.

book.headline: Tell us what the boat needs.
book.intro: Texting is fastest. If you’d rather use the form, it reaches the same people. Either way, you get a reply with what we can do and when.

placeholders.name: First and last name
placeholders.notes: Ice and groceries to the dock by 1pm Saturday. Return the wrong impeller to the chandlery and chase the refund.

book.alt_line: Or skip the form and just text us.
book.success: Got it. We’ll text you back with what we can do, by when, and the fee. If anything needs a decision, we’ll ask before we act.
book.composing: Opening your messages with the details filled in. Just hit send.
book.error_required: We’ll need this to get started.
book.privacy: Your details go to us and no one else. We text about your request, not marketing.

sms_templates.auto_reply: aBeam here. Thanks, we have your message and will text back with what we can do, by when, and the fee. If you haven’t yet, send the boat name, marina, slip, what you need and by when.
sms_templates.confirm_ready_by: aBeam here. [Boat name] at [marina], slip [slip]. We can handle [what we’ll do], at the dock by [time] on [date]. Fee: $[amount], plus [purchases and provisions] with receipts. Reply yes to confirm. Anything to add, send it now.
sms_templates.ready: aBeam here. [Boat name], slip [slip]: done. [What was done]. [Handed aboard at [time] / Left with [name] at the gate / No one came aboard.] Receipts and the note are in your log. Anything else, just text.
sms_templates.flag_issue: aBeam here. While aboard [boat name] we noticed [issue]. Flagged to you, not touched; we don’t fix. If you want it handled, we can line up a trusted local marine mechanic and coordinate the visit. Just reply.
sms_templates.conditions_brief: Brief for your [time]: [fog/sun] now, [clearing by noon]. Westerly [xx] kts, building to [xx] in the Slot by [time]. [Ebb/flood] at the Gate, max [time], so expect [chop/smooth water] off [Crissy/Alcatraz]. [Provisions at the dock by [time].]

email_confirmation.subject: aBeam: [request] for [boat name], by [time] on [date]
email_confirmation.body:
Hi [name],

Confirming your request.

Boat: [boat name], slip [slip], [marina]
Request: [what we’ll handle]
By: [time] on [date]
Fee: $[amount], quoted for this request. [Purchases, fuel and provisions are itemized on top, receipts included.]

If we come aboard and notice anything that looks off, you’ll hear from us at once; we flag, we don’t fix. If you want it handled, we line up a trusted local marine mechanic and coordinate the visit.

When it’s done you’ll get a text with a note of what was done and who came aboard, if anyone did.

Change of plans? Reply here or text us.

faq.a: The land-side list: provisions bought and brought to the dock, parts and packages collected, returns and refunds chased, jerry cans filled and propane exchanged, laundry and errands ashore, a conditions brief before you leave. For boats on the move, berths at the next stop and vendors booked and chased. Same-day requests are welcome. If it’s outside what we do, we say so and point you to someone who does it well.

Each request is quoted before we start; no hourly clock. Typically $75–150 depending on scope, with purchases, fuel and provisions itemized on top, receipts included. You’ll know the fee before we do anything. Membership for boats that need us often is coming; join the waitlist to hear first.

No. We flag, we don’t fix. Anything we notice aboard goes to the captain at once, and we stop there. If you want it handled, we line up a trusted local marine mechanic, rigger or canvas shop and see the job through.

faq.q: Do you have access to my marina yet?
faq.a: We’re launching at South Beach Harbor, Pier 39 Marina and the San Francisco Marina at Marina Green. A marina shows as serving on our chart only once dock access there is confirmed, never before. Text us the marina and slip and we’ll tell you where things stand.
